finding: owned_shape_select_same_pose_quality returned the incumbent immediately whenever any bypass owner/cap pair was on opposite faces. This prohibited quality-first preference even for an alternative with identical owner/cap faces, group pose, envelope, bulk gaps and fanout. Existing primary-rank tie dominance already permitted comparison of such matching subjects.
change: Remove only that blanket opposite-face veto. Require the existing exact subject identity (including both faces), pose/envelope/zone side, equal bulk gaps, equal valid fanout evidence and complete finite nonnegative measurements. Prefer strictly Pareto-improved bypass planar gaps; existing full-board gates remain authoritative. No new layer permission, clearance limit or electrical PASS condition.

tests.new_cases: Unchanged opposite-face subject pairs can improve; a candidate changing capacitor face in either direction cannot acquire this preference. Existing position, dimension, identity, bulk, worsening bypass, fanout and rejected-evidence mutations still reject.
